'''2014 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 Ganden Yanaga LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ganden Yanaga]] at [[2014 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Cam Solusar
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
